record.question: Which of the following is a centrally acting skeletal muscle relaxant which can be used for the management of low back pain?
record.explanation: Answer B: Chlorzoxazone. Chlorzoxazone is a centrally acting skeletal-muscle relaxant used for acute painful musculoskeletal conditions, including back pain. Source/context note: Short-term use is generally adjunctive; clinical benefit is modest and adverse effects are possible. Reference: https://dailymed.nlm.nih.gov/dailymed/search.cfm?query=chlorzoxazone. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
